Method of Attack: Ransomware attack encrypting data on targeted systems
Ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) operation targeting vulnerable Remote Desktop Services
Compromise of enterprise networks to demand large ransoms leveraging stolen corporate data
Impacted Systems: UCSF School of Medicine IT systems
Australian transportation company Toll Group systems
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerable Remote Desktop Services
Indicators of Compromise: Published stolen files including student applications with social security numbers, employee information, medical studies, and financials
Multiple servers vulnerable to CVE-2019-19781 at UCSF
